# Inherited collection interfaces

These collections have no populated public-record shape in this release's admitted workflow inventory. They remain callable for compatibility. This is a release-wide inventory statement, not a claim about a particular customer or a proof that a future extension cannot populate them. Consult an applicable product article before using one as a workflow entry.
